items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: Oh yeah I like the Heavish you know.

ctx.x: But you didn't do that record up in New York. You made that New York scene for this African-American. Well yeah well that's New York.

I mean New Jersey you cross right across the river that's New Jersey. You know what I mean. That's all New York. In other words right now you're in New Orleans and you cross the river and you go to Algiers. I mean but that's still New Orleans you know what I mean. Yeah yeah that's what you say. Yeah you just cut off a little piece up and give it a different name you know. But all you did is cross the George Watson bridge and you was right in New Jersey you know. Yeah. But the record was planned and everything and…
